column1: # Seed dictionary for public.classify_item (German). Format: term<TAB>category.
# Terms go through public.item_key, so list one form when the stem covers the
# plural (Gurke/Gurken) and both for -er plurals (Ei/Eier, Teelicht/Teelichter).
# A word matches the longest term it ends with, so short heads (milch, saft,
# gel, creme, spray, mittel, bürste, tücher) carry compounds; compounds whose
# head would mislead are listed explicitly (kokosmilch, sonnenmilch, spargel).
# Compounds of tee and keks are listed explicitly: their stems (eiste,
# butterkek) no longer end in the short term. Reis, Eis and Mais keep their s,
# Frozen markers (TK, Tiefkühl-, tiefgekühlt, gefroren) beat the food word in
# public.dictionary_category, so they are not listed here.
# - Hafer-, Soja-, Mandelmilch and -drinks sit in the Kühlregal next to milk.
# - Coffee and tea (incl. tea compounds) are pantry; ready-to-drink is drinks.
# - Spreads (Marmelade, Honig, Nutella, Erdnussbutter) are pantry.
# - Baby food, formula and baby care are Drogerie; Taschentücher too.
# - Toilet paper, Küchenrolle and cleaning cloths are Haushalt. So is pet food
#   (Katzenfutter, Hundefutter, Katzenstreu), which shares the non-food aisle.
# - Bags (-beutel, -tüte) are Haushalt; Filtertüten sit with the coffee.
# - Brand names stand for their product (Elmex, Frosch, Somat, Lenor).
# - Snack nuts (Erdnüsse, Cashews, Pistazien) are sweets; baking nuts pantry.
# - Canned fish (Thunfisch, Sardinen) is pantry; fresh and smoked fish is meat.
# - Fresh pasta, dough and deli salads are chilled; Erbsen default to frozen.
# - Fresh herbs are produce; dried spices are pantry.
